core.name: Taming Wind and Fire
core.text:
CRIT Rate +{0}% and Aftershock DMG +{1}%. Start with 100 Bottled Heat (max 125). Off-field with 60+ Energy, Corrosive Flash becomes Crimson Vortex, costing 30 Energy.
Heat Charge's laser gives the squad Zeroed In for 12s: +{2} ATK, +20 per 0.1 initial Energy Regen above 1.6 (max {3}). An Agent's Aftershock extends their Zeroed In by 4s (up to 20s).
The flame blade, all four EXs, Chain and Ultimate count as Aftershock DMG.

ability.name: Forged in Flames
ability.text: Aftershock DMG from Agents with Zeroed In ignores 25% DEF.

mindscapes: Corrosive Flash, Crimson Vortex, Heat Charge and Fiery Eruption ignore 15% Fire RES. Agents with Zeroed In deal +20% DMG.
Their Aftershocks give 65 Decibels (once per 4s). Ultimate gives +20% ATK for 45s.
Zeroed In starts at 16s. Heat Charge and Ultimate DMG +40%.

With enough Energy, press after the flame blade to go into Crimson Vortex; the flame blade gives 10 Bottled Heat. Heat Charge's low-firepower phase hits harder to interrupt. Heat Charge and Ultimate lasers add 250% ATK as Fire DMG (once per 0.5s; counts as EX and Aftershock).
